svg.title: XSLT 1.0 stylesheets, time ratio xslt3 ÷ 1.0 package (log scale)
svg.desc: On jsdom, xslt3 is 492× slower than the 1.0 package on xsl:number level="any", 8,000, its largest time ratio (492×), and 4.64× faster on 100 MB text result (0.22×); the dashed line marks equal speed.
